usage: Use 淺灰色 as a noun to name a colour. 例句：我想要淺灰色。
You can put it before a thing to describe the colour of that thing. 例句：呢件衫係淺灰色。
It often appears in shopping, design, and home-decor talk. 例句：我屋企張梳化係淺灰色。
You can also use it in short answers when people ask about colour. 例句：你鍾意咩色？淺灰色。
